name: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian
subtitle: Majora's Mask for iPhone & Vision Pro
localizedDescription: The 2 Ship 2 Harkinian port of The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask, running natively on Metal, with the enhancements menu, texture-pack support, and an Apple Vision Pro stereoscopic 3D mode. Ships with no game content: you supply your own Majora's Mask ROM and the app extracts it on device.
